title: Back off exponentially when the poller retries
body: When the GitHub API is down the poller retries at a fixed interval. Retry with exponential backoff and a cap instead.

title: Pin the LiteLLM image by digest
body: The compose file pulls LiteLLM by tag. Pin it by digest so a retagged image cannot change the gateway.

title: Add a health check to the gateway
body: The gateway container has no health check, so compose starts dependants before it can serve.
